chunks: And from him, from Safwan and Fadala ibn Ayyub and Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"It is appropriate for the Imam to pray Dhuhr in Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah, stay overnight there, and depart in the morning until the sun rises, then he departs."

key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyah (8th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed ritual schedule for the Imam on the Day of Tarwiyah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of the Imam’s specific itinerary on the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing the transition from Mecca to Mina for the night of Tarwiyah. It highlights the prophetic precedent of delaying departure until sunrise, a practice that underscores the spiritual preparation and communal unity central to the Hajj rituals in Shia jurisprudence.
